author: Leila Gharani
description:
500,000+ people have taken our courses so far. If you want to go deeper: 👉 https://link.xelplus.com/yt-d-all-courses

Hardcoded numbers hiding inside Excel formulas are almost impossible to find. Go To Special won't catch them, because the cell is a formula. Here's how to highlight every one of them automatically.

A budget file can look completely clean and still be wrong. Someone types a rate straight into a calculation instead of referencing the input cell, then forgets to update it. The formula still looks normal. Nothing errors out.

In this video I show you how to combine three things to spot them: FORMULATEXT to pull the formula out as text, REGEXTEST to check that text against a pattern, and conditional formatting so every risky formula highlights itself. No helper columns, no VBA, no add-ins.

I also cover the part most tools get wrong. Not every number inside a formula is a mistake. The 0 in ROUND sets decimal places. INDEX needs row and column numbers. Dividing by 12 turns
title: Do Your Excel Formulas Have Hardcoded Numbers? (How to Easily Spot Them)
